state.contract: Return the document only when user_id equals owner_id. Otherwise raise PermissionError.
state.assumptions: user_id and owner_id are ordinary non-null integer IDs. document is already loaded. Equality compares IDs normally. No other permission checks exist.
state.function:
L1: def read_document(user_id, owner_id, document):
L2:     if user_id == owner_id:
L3:         raise PermissionError('not owner')
L4:     return document

has_defect.instructions: Does `function` violate `contract` for any input allowed by `assumptions`? Judge functional correctness only; ignore style and hypothetical inputs excluded by the assumptions.

mechanism.instructions: Which mechanism, if any, causes `function` to violate `contract` under `assumptions`? Select no_defect if the shown implementation satisfies that contract.

criteria.inverted_guard: A rejection condition permits a forbidden input or rejects an allowed one because a comparison or boolean condition is reversed.
criteria.missing_return: A required result is not returned on a reachable path.
criteria.off_by_one: A loop or boundary includes or excludes one element incorrectly.
criteria.other: A functional defect exists but none of the listed mechanisms describes it.
criteria.no_defect: No violation of the supplied contract is present under the stated assumptions.

evidence.instructions: Which candidate line in `function` most directly contains a defect that violates `contract` under `assumptions`? Select none if no such defect is present. Select existing evidence; do not infer omitted code.
